events.content:
Added view transitions to the product gallery. The thumbnail and detail image now share a transition name so they can morph between sizes. The grid and detail pages slide in opposite directions, including when navigating with the browser Back button. Suspense content fades in from its skeleton, and `prefers-reduced-motion` disables these animations and the skeleton pulse.

The production build passed, both routes returned HTTP 200, and `git diff --check` passed. I could not visually test the animations in a browser in this environment.

item.text:
Added view transitions to the product gallery. The thumbnail and detail image now share a transition name so they can morph between sizes. The grid and detail pages slide in opposite directions, including when navigating with the browser Back button. Suspense content fades in from its skeleton, and `prefers-reduced-motion` disables these animations and the skeleton pulse.

The production build passed, both routes returned HTTP 200, and `git diff --check` passed. I could not visually test the animations in a browser in this environment.
